SELECT
    MIN(c.region) AS region,
    quantile_cont(o.amount::DOUBLE, 0.5) AS median_amount
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }} c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY LOWER(RTRIM(c.region))

JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }} c

explanation: For each customer region, this procedure takes every order placed by customers in that region and computes the median order amount (the 50th percentile, interpolated when the count is even). It saves one row per region to a table, replacing any previous version. Region matching is case-insensitive and ignores trailing spaces, as SQL Server does by default.
